claim_boundary: A PASS is independent confirmation of the fixed eight-option requirement-dominance quotient with score-exact tie continuation only for this preregistered nine-option model, R8/R16, 0.5/0.8/0.95 normalized loads, 12101--12120 synthetic Poisson tapes, 600-second arrival window plus full drain, FIFO execution, fresh full nine-option K4096 same-state shadows, full nine-option K4096 executed references, paired flow endpoint, and registered compute gates. A PASS authorizes only fixed-protocol action identity, flow parity/noninferiority, and strict reduction in the three registered B&B counters (LP calls, LP matrix coefficients, and candidate evaluations); quotient preprocessing is reported separately. It does not establish flow improvement, wall-time or total-runtime improvement, or the continuation branch unless at least one trigger is observed and resolved. It does not authorize a paper edit or a broader stability, capacity, physical-hardware, or all-queue claim.
